# This relocated dataset is described in detail here:
#

# submitted to Geophysical Research Letters. 
#

#
# Notes: 
#  These events have not been individually checked or verified.  Large errors may exist for some events.
#  Depths are nominally referenced to the elevation of Kilauea summit, 1.2 km above sea level
#  HVO preferred magnitudes (as of data download) are retained for HVO catalog events.  
#  Magnitudes of detected events have been estimated with default assumption of
#  with a factor of 10 in amplitude corresponding to 1.0 unit difference in magnitude. 
#  Caution is advised due to potential magnitude inconsistencies.  See manuscript for more details.
#  event IDs here are not HVO IDs
#
